_description: Ontology-derived symbolic constraints for Level 4 training. Defines which intent/entity_type combinations are valid, which are disallowed, and what violation penalties to apply during training. Grounded in intents_base.csv distribution and SRE domain semantics.

disallowed_intent_entity_pairs.reason: Infrastructure entities (k8s, networking, storage) are always SRE-domain; predicting out_of_scope when infrastructure is present is a violation
Service entities (application, messaging, streaming) are SRE-domain; rejecting them as out_of_scope is a false rejection
Observability/metric entities are core SRE targets; predicting out_of_scope is a false rejection
Incidents are reliability events and always SRE-domain; rejecting them is a false rejection
Jobs (cron, batch, pipeline) are SRE-managed; rejecting them is a false rejection
CI/CD pipelines and deployments are SRE-domain; rejecting them is a false rejection
Incidents are reliability events observed/summarized, not directly executed against; execution against an incident is semantically invalid
Summarization requires a reportable object; predicting summarization with no identifiable entity is a weak but notable signal
Investigation without any identifiable entity or symptom context is a weak signal of a false SRE classification

domain_validity_rules.description: Rules for domain_valid label: a prediction is domain-valid if the intent/entity combination is coherent within SRE context
domain_validity_rules.false_execution_definition: execution predicted when entity_type is metric or incident (observe/report targets, not actionable)
domain_validity_rules.false_rejection_definition: out_of_scope predicted when entity_type is not unknown

TYPE_A_FALSE_REJECTION.description: SRE-domain entity present but intent predicted as out_of_scope

TYPE_B_FALSE_EXECUTION.description: Execution predicted against a non-actionable entity type (metric or incident)
TYPE_B_FALSE_EXECUTION.detection: intent == execution AND entity_type in [metric, incident]

TYPE_C_UNGROUNDED_SRE.description: SRE intent predicted with no entity or symptom signal (unknown entity, domain_valid=False)
TYPE_C_UNGROUNDED_SRE.detection: intent != out_of_scope AND entity_type == unknown AND domain_valid == False

_grounding_note: Disallowed pairs are derived from: (1) zero-count cells in the intent x entity_type crosstab of intents_base.csv, (2) SRE semantic reasoning about what combinations are operationally invalid, (3) professor feedback on false execution and false rejection as the key violation types to measure.
